subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Should subagent lifecycle receipts and supervision actions be modeled as an extension of the metadata-only audit ledger, the task ledger, or a dedicated subagent lifecycle API?
rationale: Current main has adjacent stores and control helpers, and choosing the wrong owner would duplicate audit/task/subagent state or expose sensitive artifacts/actions without a settled contract.

options.title: Extend audit/task foundation
options.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger plus task/subagent summaries as the canonical base, then add subagent-specific receipt and supervision views on top.

options.title: Create dedicated lifecycle API
options.body: Add a separate subagent lifecycle table and Gateway contract now, accepting a narrower but potentially parallel audit source of truth.

options.title: Keep summaries only
options.body: Decline durable subagent lifecycle receipts for now and continue with task summaries, generic /stop, and internal control helpers.

recommendation.title: Extend audit/task foundation
recommendation.body: Use the metadata-only audit ledger plus task/subagent summaries as the canonical base, then add subagent-specific receipt and supervision views on top.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent metadata-only audit foundation and is the clearest owner for deciding whether this belongs in audit, tasks, or a new subagent lifecycle API.
